resolution, orderliness, and the creation of an indivisible society. It is

not merely a meeting of like-minded individuals. For instance, the

meeting of two thieves or two robbers is not sanyog as it does not aim

for resolution and orderliness.

As I became capable of living with justice, my family itself became the

practice ground of my authenticity. As one starts living with justice,

they start gaining the acceptance of their family. After living with

justice in my family, I started getting recognised for my righteousness

among the families of our friends also. After this, living with justice

became my intrinsic nature, and I became capable of conveying my

righteous identity to visitors as well.

Every human has an innate desire for meaningfulness and success.

Our understanding is the source of this noble desire, and we can

never ignore this source. Good is acceptable to everyone; all humans

107 desire goodness and are waiting for it to manifest. As we wait, the

issue of relationships arises. Understanding relationships involves

recognising their inherent purpose (values). This recognition is the

essence of study.

Once the purpose of relationships is understood, one naturally

becomes dedicated and subsequently achieves mastery. Mastery

invariably bears fruit. This method of achieving success is quite

simple. Comprehensive resolution is fundamentally linked with all

relationships.

The purpose of relationships is comprehensive resolution, meaning

all relationships aim for resolution and happiness. It is only with this

resolution that we love, become grateful, make friends, trust, engage

in social behaviour, and experience happiness. Values such as care,

guidance, trust, affection, gratitude, glory, love, reverence, and respect

form the basis of our interactions. Gratitude acknowledges any help

we receive for our comprehensive resolution. With gratitude, other

values start to manifest. Following gratitude, the values of affection,

love, and trust naturally develop.

There is no one who has never received help in some form or another.

It is through everyone's help that a person grows, becomes

autonomous, and is evidenced. All relationships (the seven

relationships) have continuity when values are realised within them.

Relationships without values lack continuity. Even in daily life, we

interact well with those we recognise as part of our relationships.

108 Traditionally, we identify relationships based on power, wealth,

intelligence, or age. However, in reality, our relationships are meant

first for evidencing comprehensive resolution, second for nurturing,

third for protection, fourth for usefulness and complementariness,

fifth for right-use, and sixth for purposeful-use. Authenticity is the

highest priority in relationships. Everyone is satisfied on the basis of

authenticity. Values naturally emerge from jeevan. For example, when

you and I meet, trust develops naturally through the flow of values.

This approach allows us to recognise values in our relationships,

evaluate them, and achieve mutual satisfaction. What greater benefit

is there? Until now, we recognised relationships based on fear and

temptation, but now we prioritise values, evaluation, resolution, and

prosperity. Fear and temptation are not values, so their evaluation is

meaningless. Fear and temptation are two sides of the same coin.

Their temporary use might bring some order, but the underlying

issue remains.

Even in courts, justice cannot be truly delivered because it cannot be

based on fear and temptation. For centuries, humans have made

compromises based on fear and temptation, but this has not brought

about any lasting order. We can agree that fear and temptation are

not values and cannot be evaluated in relationships.

Humans haven't truly grasped values yet. If they had, values would

be expressed, evidenced, evaluated, and justice would occur naturally.

Judicial courts pass judgments; they don’t administer justice. One

109 side consents to these judgments out of fear, while the other side

consents out of temptation. Mutual satisfaction was never achieved

there, nor can it be. We have been completely incapable of achieving

justice. Despite this, we claim to have made progress. It is for you to

decide what such development truly means.

Every human naturally desires to be free from fear and temptation.

Living without these is beneficial for both humans and their natural

surroundings. Relationships are based on purpose. The purpose is

resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence. The process for

this is living in orderliness. Living in orderliness means participating

in all five dimensions. These five dimensions are: 1.

Education-Sanskar, 2. Justice-Security. 3. Health-Restraint, 4.

Production-Work, 5. Exchange-Reserve

In this way, by living orderly in a family and participating in the five

dimensions, we become participants in the universal orderliness. This

brings continuous joy, well-being, and indomitable courage to

humans. Dharma follows justice. Dharma means the enlightenment

of realisation-evidence in buddhi, i.e., resolution. Resolution is the

dharma of humans. Living in orderliness is the dharma of humans,

which is the state of comprehensive resolution. When humans live in

disorder, they become trapped in problems; when they live in

orderliness, they remain resolved. Humans do not want to be trapped

in problems; they want to be resolved. Resolution equals happiness;

human dharma is happiness. Problems equal suffering; humans do

not want suffering.

110 Resolution cannot be attained based on fear and temptation, yet the

whole world is bent on finding resolution that way. Even today, we

educate and train to build systems based on fear and temptation, but

orderliness cannot come from these. The moment anything is built

based on fear and temptation, the process of its disintegration begins

immediately.

Orderliness at any level – family, industry, governance, or State – can

only be achieved based on values and evaluation. Orderliness means

that humans can exhibit their authenticity, fulfil justice, and

participate.

The education-sanskar system aims to impart the formula of

understanding to every family, individual, and child. This process can

also be referred to as the dissemination of understanding. As

mentioned earlier, first comes the holistic view (darshan), followed

by ideology (vaad), then treatises (shastra), and finally, plans

(yojana). One of these plans is the Jeevan Vidya Plan, which enables

any family to achieve humane consciousness. With this

understanding, one can live in orderliness within the family.

The second plan is the Humanisation of Education, which provides a

system of education for children. We implemented this education

system at a school in Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, over a period of five years.

This experience allowed us to observe the impact of humanising

education based on Jeevan Vidya.

111 People often say that the environment influences students, a notion I

have always disagreed with. If the environment had such an

overriding effect, how could I have succeeded in my exploration?

Evidence from this school shows that children influence their

families, and in turn, families influence their environment. The

children began to see themselves as jeevan (conscious beings) rather

than merely as bodies, and they recognised the necessity of living in

orderliness.

As a result, many children started losing interest in television and

frivolous talks, evaluating them as meaningless. Additionally,

conflicts, fights, and ill-will among families in the village began to

diminish. To my knowledge, these villages now experience fewer

disputes and conflicts. I assert that the environment shaped by the

children's conduct had a significant impact, and on this basis, I claim

that this education system is effective.

As part of the humanisation of education plan, we will impart the

study of the sentient aspect along with science. Study of sentient

aspect means study of jeevanand its awakening. We will study

composition and decomposition in the physicochemical world, how

it is complementary for humans and how humans can be

complementary and useful for these. Along with this, we will study

the activity aspect in alternative philosophy, which is to say that

philosophy is for the understanding of human beings.

Understanding should be evidenced. When we build our identities

112 with understanding only coexistence is recognised in our

relationships, values are fulfilled, and mutual satisfaction results.

Orderliness is a perpetual truth in coexistence. Each unit in existence

has inherent orderliness. For example - oak-ness is the inherentness in

an oak tree. A peepal tree maintains its definite conduct with all its

fruits, seeds and leaves exhibiting peepal’s properties, intrinsic nature

and dharma. In the same way, the conduct of entire units of plant

world and animal world is definite, each exhibiting their respective

definite conducts. This is inherent orderliness. The conduct of

humans could not become definite until now, because humans could

not live in orderliness until now. We humans haven’t accomplished

orderliness yet but we have reached the point of feeling that it is

needed.

We will need to live with the inherent orderliness of humans to

accomplish it. What is the inherentness of humans? Inherentness in

humans is humaneness, or humane conduct, consisting of values,

character and ethics. The evidence of values is relationships, values,

evaluation, and mutual satisfaction - which has to be there in a

family. Mutual satisfaction is essential for a family and more than

that is not even needed. This itself is humaneness. This will happen

when humans spontaneously live with values. The issue of character

will need to be addressed for living in orderliness. Character has been

recognised as rightfully owned wealth, marital faithfulness, and

kindness in work and behaviour. Ethics are the right-use and

protection of resources in the form of body, mind and wealth –

113 which leads to fearlessness (trust) in human living. This is the

description of humane conduct in which humans can live nicely with

assurance.

Now we come to the definition of a human being: "A human is one

who materialises ideas." This means that a human being actualises

whatever comes to their mind (like building a machine, a house, etc.)

and lives in the hope of mental well-being or happiness. Happiness is

the dharma of humans. Through this understanding, we grasp the

essence of values, character, and ethics.

According to this definition, humans have achieved the aspect of

materialising ideas. There are two types of idea materialisation: one

for common aspirations (food, shelter, clothing) and the other for

special aspirations (telecommunication and transportation).

However, evidence of humane conduct is absent today. It is neither

found in education nor in the Constitution. The Constitution lacks

any provision for evaluating humane conduct. Any power-centric

Constitution does not include provisions for evidencing humane

conduct, as it is not inherently humane. Consequently, humane

conduct cannot be expected from such a constitution.

No one has been able to evidence humane conduct based on this

system. Humans have neither mustered the courage for such

evaluation nor gathered such understanding. Humans will not be

able to live happily and will continue to fight unless these deficiencies

114 are addressed. Understanding is the only way out of this messy

situation. The humanisation of education is crucial for this purpose.

We will integrate the study of the conscious aspect (jeevan) in science,

the activity aspect of nature in philosophy, the sanskar aspect in

psychology, and human and humaneness aspects in geography and

history. By incorporating humaneness into education, humans will

naturally tend to live in orderliness and evidence themselves.

It is only with our true identity (of humaneness) that we will live

with the possibility, necessity, and success of resolution, prosperity,

fearlessness, and coexistence. Therefore, education and sanskar

become complete only with humaneness, not by any other means.

The sanskars we talk about at present are based solely on our

prevalent beliefs, and they lack universality.

The third point is the ‘truth’. What is the truth? Truth is to

understand existence in the form of coexistence. One understands

existential orderliness upon understanding truth. Existence is studied

only in the form of nature saturated in Omnipotence. Humans and

the rest of nature are complementary to one another. As one

develops the lifestyle according to this understanding, it only results

in humane orderliness. Once this is understood, we will live only in

justice, we will live only in orderliness, and we will evidence only

authenticity in our families and in our behaviour. We will not engage

in power-centric rule. In this way, we reach the point of complete

assurance, trust, and prosperity.

115 At present, it is taught in science that all that exists is basically chaos

and uncertainty. Upon studying this, students start believing that

they are also in chaos, and in turn, they start spreading chaos. Earth’s

present condition illustrates this clearly. Earth’s temperature is rising.

What is the root cause? The temperature is rising due to the

extraction of minerals, coal, and petroleum from the Earth's interior.

They know, and we know, how and why the temperature has risen.

Coal and petroleum are the only substances that absorb heat, and

once we extracted these heat-absorbing substances, it was natural for

the Earth’s temperature to rise. This rise in temperature has resulted

in the rise of sea levels. How much could the sea levels rise? The place

where we are sitting could have water levels two to three hundred feet

high. Only a few hilltops might be left above water. This is how we

have become stuck. Many developed nations call out saying, "Let us

fix this situation together." We know very well from history who

started it. We extracted coal and petroleum without understanding,

which is an assault on Earth. We can test whether Earth could recover

only after these assaults stop. How will these stop? We will talk about

it later. Humans survive on Earth from very low to very high

temperatures. Human body temperature remains the same

everywhere despite so much variation in outside temperature. How

does this happen? The body has substances that keep its temperature

balanced. In the same way, coal and petroleum are the substances that

maintain Earth’s temperature.

116 The present challenge is how can we stop the extraction of coal and

petroleum? One solution could be to harness the energy from the

powerful flow of rivers on the surface of the Earth. We can generate

50 times more electricity than our requirement this way. We need to

develop efficient turbines for this. Second, there are some machines

which only run with oil; for these, we will need to make engines that

run with vegetable oil. There are oilseed vegetations which could be

grown in large quantities, I think. Third, solar energy is already in

focus; it needs more urgent attention. We need to make more and

more machines and industries work with solar energy. In this way, we

understand that there is more energy than our requirements available

on Earth’s surface. We can stop the use of coal and petroleum by

replacing them with alternative sources of energy. It is only then can

we test Earth’s capacity to heal from the wounds inflicted by humans

so far.

There’s one more sword hanging over our heads. If we analyse the

event of water formation, when it first occurred on Earth, we will

find that this event was caused by the conjunction of cosmic rays.

Cosmic rays are the only cause of this event, and subsequently, the

continuity of water has become established on Earth. There has been

degradation in Earth’s environment. This could lead to the

possibility of the same cosmic rays affecting in an adverse manner and

causing water to disappear from Earth. Scientists have identified all

the sources which have caused damage to the environment. Merely

identifying these sources will not fix the damage; we need to rebuild.

117 Rebuilding requires us to first stop the excesses we have been

committing against Earth. We read in newspapers how the extraction

of fossil fuels, coal, and the use of poisonous materials in warfare have

caused immense damage to Earth’s shield, i.e., the atmosphere. If it is

true, then we will have to stop all such activities. It is a great quality

of humans that they think of reparation after causing damage, a

quality not found in animals. However, humans haven’t done

anything to repair the damage they have caused to the environment.

On the contrary, it is getting worse by the day. How long can it go on

like this? Will we ever do anything to repair the damage we have

inflicted on Earth?

Earth has kept provisioning for humans to live safely, but humans

with all their intelligence rebelled, attacked and exploited Earth.

Humans have been engaged in damaging their environment from the

very beginning. The damage increased with the coming of the

scientific age, therefore we now find ourselves in trouble. If a man is

drowning in a river, then there is still a possibility that he may

resurface, and get saved. It is up to us now, whether we want to act on

the possibility of saving Earth. Circumstances are created from

thoughts. If we want something then circumstances become

favourable for it, and if we don’t want something then circumstances

become unfavourable for it. It is because of our own lack of

understanding that we erred in the evaluation of reality, and the

magnificence of the natural environment. As a result, we caused

damage to nature and harmed ourselves in many ways. While causing

118 this damage, we have been enjoying ourselves, but we are afraid also

of the possibility of getting harmed ourselves. This is the analysis of

the past.

When humans become ready for living in orderliness based on

humane consciousness, only then Jeevan vidya is transmitted from

one to another. Its evidence has come. We have been able to do this

successfully in one school. Looking at the good results here, there is a

need for its widespread dissemination.

No-one commits a wrong act without ignorance. According to me,

every human wants good and takes responsibility for good. Hence,

sooner or later humans will feel responsible for the good of all.

Awakening of jeevanis only for actualising this universal good. This

discussion about understanding and jeevan’s awakening is initiated

only with the intent of forming a healthy society and freedom from

the traps of comfort-accumulation and devotion-detachment. The

evidencing of enlightenmentand resolve activities of buddhi can

happen only when it attains the enlightenment of justice, dharma

and truth. It is when these three are comprehended that buddhi is

called sadbuddhi - whereby a human accepts responsibility for the

good of all. It is upon comprehending existence that we become

aware of it being eternally present as coexistence, which itself is the

object of study.

The concept of splitting was arrived at by a mathematical approach.

Nuclear fission or splitting of the atom was discovered for making

119 increasingly more powerful nuclear bombs. The purpose of making

atomic bombs can be nothing apart from destruction. Apart from

destruction like Hiroshima, the nuclear tests that were carried out

again and again have caused more damage to the environment. These

acts were carried out by a very few people but their consequences will

be borne by the entire world. This is how common people are

harmed by these destructive acts. The mathematical approach

reduces ‘the present’ to an infinitesimal duration, and ‘the present’

seems to disappear. While the reality is just its opposite. The present

is eternal. There is nothing apart from the present. Entire grandeur of

existence is eternally present, while the present becomes non-existent

by approach of fragmenting. Such a big bundle of lies has been made

this way, now humans will have to have confidence in their own

selves to overcome it. As long as humans derive their confidence from

an atom bomb, sword, flag or stone - they will not trust each other, it

is a fact. Humans will have confidence in themselves when they

understand themselves. In order to understand themselves, every

man and woman will need to precisely understand justice, dharma

and truth, which is the expression of jeevan. How do we understand

justice, dharmaand truth? Justice is understood on the basis of

relationships. Dharmais understood on the basis of ‘orderliness’.

Truth is understood on the basis of existence. Coexistence is always

effective, as a manifestation of coexistence. Apart from humans, the

entire grandeur of the other three orders is in the form of orderliness

only.

120 Humans too have an inherent thirst, to whatever extent, of being in

orderliness. It is not possible to gain the concept of orderliness by

studying the (prevalent) textbooks of delusion. It is only upon

understanding the concept of orderliness and living thereby that

humans become capable of abiding by dharma. Human dharma

indeed is to live in ‘orderliness’. Every entity in existence being in

orderliness and participating in orderliness itself is seen in the form of

dharma. Dharmaof material order is existing (being). Dharmaof

biological order is growth with existing. Dharmaof animal order is

the hope of living along with growth and existence. Dharmaof

knowledge order (humans) is continuity of happiness along with

hope of living, growth and existence. Happiness itself is the

dharmaof humans. How will happiness be achieved? Through

resolution. Resolution will be achieved by living in orderliness.

Living in orderliness depends on understanding in humans.

Understanding is to have enlightenment of existence, jeevanand

humane conduct (in buddhi).

Enlightenment of orderliness (in buddhi) naturally results in

dedication and resolve in orderliness. Humans live in orderliness with

this dedication and resolve, and by living thus we can create good

conditions. Therefore, we will have to adopt humane education

which will give rise to sadbuddhi in humans. There is no other way

of saving this Earth from complete disaster. We should understand

this proposal. It is needed. Circumstances will compel us to

understand it if we don't pay heed now.

121 Therefore, abiding by dharmais to live in universal orderliness and

indivisible society with evidence of resolution, prosperity, fearlessness

and coexistence. In this way, I have understood humaneness to be the

universal orderliness of humans. Human race is one – actions are

many. Human dharmais one - resolutions are many. Unless

humans recognise themselves as one race, how can they do anything

good for all humans? Humans can perform many kinds of actions for

living with happiness. The meaning of many kinds of actions means

performing different works like tailoring, masonry, farming, etc. It is

natural for humans to do many kind of works. Many kind of work

here means production activities. We can accept the oneness of the

human race by seeing that the objective of all humans is only one –

which is to become happy, to become prosperous, to become

resolved, to have fearlessness, and to continuously evidence

coexistence. Any plan that we make for satisfying these objectives can

only be based on the principle that “human race is one, human

dharmais one.” The path to happiness is called dharma(orderliness).

The way orderliness can be evidenced at one place and time upon

becoming wise, it can be evidenced at every place and time. That is

the beauty of this proposal.

May there be universal well-being!

122

Questions and Answers

This part of the book has a selection of some questions asked

by students of Jeevan Vidya and their answers given by Shree

A Nagraj.

Question: - Do material objects have no value?

Answer: - Usefulness value of material objects is definite. The

usefulness value of one kilogram of wheat today is the same as what it

was one hundred years ago. We only brought its value down by

interfering in it (for example by using chemical fertilisers). People

became averse to labour from using chemical fertilisers, as they

stopped making manure from dung and started killing farm animals

for their meat. They say, we make money by killing animals and

exporting their meat etc. How far is that right? How far is that

practical? How far is that good for humans? Who is answerable? For

prosperity, it is essential that material objects have value - as the fruit

of human labour. Material objects are used in three ways - the body's

nourishment, protection and social participation. All these objects

are to be used by humans, without these they cannot be fully happy.

Question: - What is dharma of humans, and what is faith?

Answer: - The dharmaof all humans is happiness. Many faiths are

there only because this factis not understood and is not commonly

accessible. The extent to which I live in abundance and in orderliness

today, I can live even better tomorrow, such living with increasing

123 happiness is called dharma. It is not possible to be happy with

problems. One can become happy only upon attaining resolution

from understanding. We attain resolution on the basis of material

things and then become happy, it doesn’t work like this.

Understanding, hence resolution, is inherent in our buddhi through

awakening. One becomes capable of producing and using material

things righteously on the basis of understanding.

It is not possible to have a situation where we are resolved and we

don’t have any material things. Definite measures of material things

meant for prosperity, are also included with resolution, which is

evidenced while living in a family. It is with this balance that we pave

the way of living with happiness. These material things (while living

with resolution) are the needs of abiding in dharma.

Until now, no sectarian ritual could become universal, nor would

they ever in future. Universality in humans will be only of

orderliness, good of all, and happiness. I have understood the way

humans live in orderliness and participate in universal orderliness.

No one has any problems with me, the way I live. In this way, we

come to this conclusion that the dharmaof humans is happiness

with resolution. Living in orderliness results in continuity of

resolution and happiness. When jeevanbecomes happy then

resolution is evidenced in human behaviour. We can accept that a

human is happy based on evidence in their behaviour.

124 All humans naturally want to be resolved and without exception

want to be happy - whether they are dark, fair, mighty, weak, rich, or

poor. Since time immemorial, the method of becoming happy has

been to search for happiness in sensual pleasures, but that hasn’t

worked. Consequently, it has become clear now that understanding

is the basis of becoming happy. Understanding is when humans have

understood themselves and existence.

Existence is an eternal truth, which doesn’t increase or decrease.

What is the evidence of this? All that is there around us is the present.

Present never ends, it is continuous. This Earth may have four orders

or just one. At the minimum one order (material order) continues to

remain. Physical entities continue to exist, these are never

annihilated. The physical entities only manifest as chemical entities,

which is called chemical resonance (rasaynik urmi). Two physical

entities come together while leaving their prior conducts and making

a third kind of conduct - that is chemical resonance. All entities of

biological order were formed as a result of chemical resonance. The

chemical entities naturally give rise to the emergence of pran-kosha,

pran-sutra, and rachna vidhi. There is no contribution from any

engineers, doctors or intellectuals in this. Hence, we come to know

that the steps of development progression are well established in

existence. Humans are also a step in this progression, you and I can

understand this. If humans don’t live in orderliness in their activities

and thoughts, as per their position in development progression, then

Earth will not remain habitable for them and humans will get wiped

125 out. The rest of the physical and chemical entities will remain as is,

but the human race will vanish from Earth. There is no gain or loss in

existence, i.e. existence neither increases nor decreases. The four

orders are continuously present. This is the way of existence. If all the

four orders are not together on this Earth, they will be on some other

planet. What would be more foolish than humans thinking that their

development is in making Earth uninhabitable?

Most people consider a person, nation or sect that causes such

nuisance to be developed. This requires some rethinking. It has now

become evident that we are stuck due to our own doing. We need to

untangle ourselves now. The proposal for this has been presented to

you. It needs to be thought over and your cooperation is essential in

this. Humans turn to good or bad tendencies with their own will. If

they don’t find the path to good, they rush towards bad tendencies.

This proposal is for going towards good, it needs to be considered

and its path needs to be recognised.

First – The humane character is the same for all humans. It is in the

form of rightfully owned wealth, marital faithfulness, and kindness

in work and behaviour.

Second – Values flow upon recognising relationships. Values are

fulfilled upon recognition, evaluation and mutual satisfaction in

relationships.

Third – We are ethical only when we make right-use and ensure

protection of our resources in the form of body, mind, and wealth.

126 In this way, humane conduct is a combined expression of values,

character and ethics. These three are the cornerstones for living in

orderliness. Humane conduct is the formula and I arrived at the

humane constitution when I elaborated it for human living in family,

society, vocation and nature. The grandeur of humane conduct alone

can be manifested as national character. The erstwhile thinking of

statecraft based on religion and economics has failed. We will now

need to search for the alternative. The proposal for this is to define

the national character on the basis of humane conduct. Nowhere and

at no point in time will anyone have difficulty in understanding it.

For once, we need to experience the happiness of living with humane

conduct. As we elaborate the humane conduct and the humane

constitution in the form of the code of humane conduct, it takes the

form of sociology. Education needs to incorporate humane sociology.

How will humans become wise? What is the grandeur of a human

with humaneness? How does a human with humaneness live in

family, in society, and in systems? All this falls under sociology, which

is a subject of study in itself. Humans can live very nicely while

trusting the present. Existence neither increases nor decreases,

therefore we can recognise existence in the form of the ultimate

truth.

Nature saturated in Omnipotence itself is existence. The present can

never be destroyed. We are intellectually unresolved in the present

because of our inability to live in orderliness. We therefore escape to

the past and the future (in our memory), which makes us frustrated

127 and miserable. There is no disorder in existence. Existence is in

absolute orderliness.

When a human constructs something, it inevitably deteriorates. For

example, when one makes a machine, it eventually breaks down.

When one constructs a house, it starts deteriorating after some time.

However, matter is never destroyed. So even when a house is reduced

to dust, we can reconstruct it with our labour. Jeevan has

inexhaustible strengths and powers which we use for the

nourishment and protection of the body and social participation. We

call this prosperity. We may need to use the phone a few times a day,

but the phone is available twenty-four hours a day - that’s prosperity.

Our requirement is to go out once a day, but the bicycle is available

all day at home – if that’s not prosperity, then what is it? We require

only one quintal of grain for food, but our production is 20 quintals

– that’s prosperity. These examples illustrate that resources are

plentiful, and needs are less. We can experience prosperity in all

aspects of our living. Experiencing prosperity is a human need. If

there is any use of the material world, then it is that humans may

experience prosperity. There is only one way to experience prosperity,

and that is to produce in excess of our family’s needs. The continuity

of resolution is ensured by living in orderliness with prosperity. Once

understanding is attained, upon resolution, we have its eternal

continuity and we don’t need to strive for it anymore. This itself is

the basis of feeling good. It is not possible to feel good whenever one

thinks of a problem. In this way, understanding is the basis of

128 resolution, deploying labour is the basis of prosperity, and living in

orderliness with coexistence is the basis of experiencing fearlessness.

This I have seen, understood, and lived - which I am capable of

imparting to you.

Justice = Being capable of living in indivisible society and universal

orderliness. Truth = Being capable of authenticity.

Being authentic means that what we have understood, we can impart

it to others. The only formula for understanding is to understand

orderliness, understand justice, and understand humans. I am among

those who have become successful in understanding these.

The realisation results in evidence. What is realisation? Realisation is

the point of satisfaction of knowing and believing. If we only keep

believing, but don’t know, then we won’t find the point of

satisfaction. If we know, but don’t believe, then too we won’t find

the point of satisfaction. It is when we find satisfaction in both

knowing and believing, that we find satisfaction in recognising and

fulfilling. Thus far, we couldn’t find satisfaction in the course of

recognising and fulfilling, because we lacked knowing and believing.

We either know but don’t believe, or we believe but don’t know.

How to recognise the point of satisfaction of knowing and believing?

It will be recognised through contemplation. That which gets

accepted as enlightenment (in buddhi), we start its revelation within

ourselves, which eventually reaches the point of satisfaction. The

authenticity comes along with the point of satisfaction. Authenticity

129 is evidence in itself. This is how the way of communicating and

expressing the realisation emerges. We find satisfaction in ourselves

upon communicating and expressing realisation in human tradition,

which is our true wealth. I become satisfied when I could

communicate my realisation to you, which itself is the evidence of my

realisation. If you achieve this understanding, then it is further joy for

me, and even if you don’t understand, my satisfaction remains intact

with me. We can communicate realisation eternally.

According to erstwhile idealism, the realisation cannot be expressed.

On the basis of recognising jeevan, I understood that realisation is its

integral activity. Evidence of realisation is possible only in the human

tradition. Understanding is the only requirement for evidencing

realisation, no material substance is required for this. Understanding

is about knowing, believing, recognising and fulfilling. The activities

of knowing and believing happen within jeevan. These activities are

not based on sensory experience; therefore, they don’t require any

material substance. When it comes to recognising and fulfilling, we

participate in orderliness as humans. Realisation has no deployment

of the body. It directly makes the mun joyous. Mun, joyous from

realisation, reveals it to the world. Realisation that happens in atma

is the basis of being joyful. The majesty of atma itself is the basis of

fascination and joy. Atma has the content of realisation, so mun

offers it to the world. Mun has so much joy that it is bound to offer.

When we have a bountiful amount of something we naturally offer it

to others. Realisation is such a big bounty that mun can’t contain it

130 to itself and starts expressing it. I have seen, understood, and realised

this. In the past, our elders kept stating that realisation cannot be

expressed in words. We will now have to study which of these

statements is to be believed. Realisation can be expressed if a human

wants. It is clear that realisation can be expressed. The event is right

before you.

After realisation, comes presenting it in the form of evidence. So far,

evidence has been presented either as instrumental evidence or

scriptural evidence. The evidence that can establish the truth hasn’t

yet been presented. It is a fact that instrumental evidence is variable.

Scientists themselves say that it is not necessarily the final truth. Now

it has become a big dilemma to understand what the final

truth is, what is the initial truth, what is the in-between truth,

what is the close-by truth, and what is the far-off truth? There

is truth and there is untruth. Untruth means humans are

living in delusion. There is no reality in existence by the name

“untruth”. We could call our ignorance and our delusion

“untruth”. Truth is all that exists. Truth neither decreases nor

increases. There is no such thing as initial truth or final truth. There

is only continuous truth. Or one can be in the state of not having

understood the truth. Truth is realised only upon understanding.

Understanding coexistence itself is the ultimate truth.

The result of understanding existence is realisation that existence is in

orderliness itself. Since existence itself is in the form of orderliness, it

is natural for humans to have an inherent tendency to strive for

131 orderliness. Then we came to know that human dharmais only one,

and it is living in orderliness. The triumph of human dharmais only

in living in orderliness.

Trusting the present itself is being happy. However, there can be no

evidence of being happy with the solution described in

devotion-detachment. Sadhana culminates in detachment as the

state of samadhi. It is impossible to say whether one is happy or

unhappy in the state of samadhi. One cannot testify samadhi,

therefore that state is said to be beyond happiness or unhappiness. If

you attain the state of samadhi, you too will see the same. Samadhi is

a state that is bereft of thoughts. I have seen it myself. Samadhi is a

possible but not a definite event. No one can tell who will achieve the

state of samadhi and when. It is not possible to say how one will

achieve samadhi, since there are many methods for it – sadhana

vidhi, agantukvidhi, yog vidhi, dhyan vidhi, puja vidhi, japa vidhi.

When we start living in orderliness, our participation aligns with it.

Participating in education-sanskar can be achieved through

continuous benevolence. Education-sanskar is meaningful only

through benevolence, not remuneration. Education-sanskar for

remuneration cannot impart the enlightenment of truth and

essential understanding. I impart education-sanskar benevolently,

without expecting any material reward. Imparting understanding

doesn't require material resources.

132 Teachers in educational programmes must be autonomous and

self-reliant. Understanding that an autonomous person will naturally

be self-reliant, produce essential goods, be capable, and benevolent.

Every human has an inherent tendency for cooperation and

benevolence, which can be surveyed. Benevolence can be taught to

children based on this. By nurturing a child's cooperative tendencies,

they naturally develop into benevolent adults. We need to create

provisions in education to nurture this tendency, achievable only

through humane education. Industrial and professional education

cannot achieve this.

Focusing on this, we can develop education addressing behaviour,

orderliness, and evidence. Humans must be the basis of evidence.

Industrial and professional education cannot make humans social; it

inevitably results in exploitation of the Earth. The Earth has been

ruined by industrial and professional education. Therefore, we need

humane education, behavioural education, resolutionistic education,

and authentic education. Such education should centre around

humane conduct. We need to develop comprehensive content to

make humans wise and secure humane conduct.

We see that people perform acts of agitation and excitement instantly,

but when it comes to actions requiring resolution, wisdom, or

purposefulness, they think ten times over before acting. Such a

tendency is not seen in childhood. As one grows older, doubts about

one’s cooperative nature begin to arise, and cooperation becomes less

of a priority. Eventually, it is too late, and one’s circumstances also

133 change. The changed circumstances only reinforce one’s doubts

about the wisdom in cooperation, and slowly one takes a stand that

nothing good is possible, or that we can’t do anything good in this

world. On the other hand, every human naturally wants orderliness.

This proposal is for how orderliness can become accessible, and how

it can become common. Humans will have to become wise for this.

Orderliness is to evidence humane conduct in every aspect, angle,

direction and context in human living. This results in resolution,

prosperity, fearlessness and coexistence, for which humans have been

striving and waiting for ages.

At present, people consider their own needs to be justified but not

the needs of others. This is why one person exploits another, one

family exploits another family, one community exploits another

community, and one country exploits another country. This

observation makes it clear that we need to understand and recognise

human dharma and humane conduct, and muster dedication and

courage to actualise it in this very lifetime. This is called resolve,

which involves dedication for evidence. Dedication is required for

living in orderliness and expressing authenticity. It also involves a

continuous commitment to justice—living justly and striving for

justice. This dedication will lead to justice, dharma, and truth. I do

not see any other way to achieve this. Dedication in worship,

recitation, and meditation only reinforces and enhances the needs for

which we undertake these activities. It is said that these practices are

performed to satisfy acute inquisitiveness for knowledge or for

134 attaining moksha. Since time immemorial, these practices have been

considered auspicious. They have popular acceptance and respect,

and many people find relief in them. However, temporary relief does

not mean that we have become capable of living in orderliness. It is

not that I mistrust worship, recitation, meditation, etc., but they are

effective only up to a certain limit. Beyond this, there is the desire for

moksha, whose ultimate destination is samadhi, where there is

nothing to gain or lose.

Therefore, we arrive at the conclusion that the path of devotion,

detachment, or accumulation does not lead to orderliness. Then,

how should humans live? The art of humane living is to live with

resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence. I have

experienced living this way, and it is meaningful. You can also live it.

We have reached the point where every person can evidence it by

living it. Meaningfulness is acceptable and embraceable to all

humans. Humane conduct is meaningful for humankind. Every unit

in existence tends to be in orderliness, which itself is their dharma.

Humans also want to live in orderliness, and on this basis,

humaneness is acceptable to them. Evidencing humaneness itself is

the evidence of our awakening.

When I evidenced humane conduct, I realised that humaneness itself

is my identity and grandeur, and joy started flowing continuously. I

believe the whole of humankind is also thirsting for humaneness.

Humaneness is the identity of humans; they will not be able to run

away from it. Sooner or later, they will have to come around to it.

135 Each human has the inherent possibility and the potential treasure

for realising humane tradition. The evidence is based on each

human’s desire, need, and enthusiasm. If just one person had a

propensity for orderliness while others went about their lives

mechanically, then everyone wouldn’t have had the need and desire

for becoming happy.

Someone or the other has always occupied a seat of power, but even

they didn’t find happiness, self-governance, and freedom; and those

who looked up to the seat of power also didn’t find any of it. This

tells us that all of us are still empty-handed. The only alternative for

filling this void is that every human lives with developed

consciousness. Humane education is the only way for human

awakening. Whatever efforts I have made towards it are out of my

happiness. I am not doing it as a favour or obligation. I profess this

based on the enlightenment of realisation (realisation is authenticity,

and its enlightenment happens in buddhi). This itself is called

resolve. We have the desire to express and communicate our

understanding based on this resolve. This also gives rise to a tendency

for evidencing. I evidenced and found that it is everyone’s need, and

upon realising this, I started presenting its further programs.

The first endeavour is the Jeevan Vidya Plan. Here, I have explained

the activities of jeevan, such as contemplation, resolve, and

realisation. The resolve naturally manifests in that person in the form

of visualisation as a way of living. Earlier, visualisation used to be

based on sensitivity. Now, visualisation starts happening for a way of

136 living with authenticity. Such living is called the way of benevolence.

When we visualise our common and special aspirations through the

way of benevolence, we realise that we can be benevolent only when

we are autonomous, i.e., when we are evidencing resolution and

prosperity. This ability cannot be hidden away, it gets naturally

deployed in benevolence. Our common and special aspirations

become limited in this way.

This formula of living encompasses cyclical economics, or it naturally

leads to it. Humans can understand this, and it indeed becomes clear

upon awakening. In this way, with cyclical economics, we devote our

resources (body, mind and wealth) ethicallyin behaviour, production

and orderliness. For example, we deploy our resources in education.

Therefore, the opportunities for righteous deployment of resources

are always there, and the way of availing these emerges on its own

upon awakening.

In modern times, one gradually starts losing interest in production

after their studies and thirsts for more and more comfort and

accumulation. However, upon awakening through humane way of

living in orderliness our common and special aspirations become

limited (definite), i.e. our needs become satisfied with fewer

resources.

The object value remains constant. For example, whatever value

(usefulness) is there in one kilogram sesame seeds, it has always been

the same. Similarly, the value of medicine, rice, wheat, vegetables, etc

137 also remains constant. This is called usefulness value. Also, there are

things that humans produce - such as cars, trains, etc. - where

aesthetic value gets added. Aesthetics is meaningful when it adds

convenience to usefulness. This is the basis of our analysis for

recognising usefulness, meaningfulness and aesthetics.

Among the values, jeevanvalues are known by the names –

happiness, peace, contentment and bliss, which are only names

of the state of harmony within jeevan. Happiness is when there

is harmony in mun and vritti, peace is when there is harmony

in vritti and chitta, contentment is when there is harmony in

chitta and buddhi, and bliss is when there is harmony in

buddhi and atma. This altogether is harmony in jeevan. When

we live based on realisation then it is effortless and natural for jeevan

to be in harmony. This harmony isjeevan’s natural expectation,

accomplishment and meaningfulness.It is when the taste activity (of

mun) starts having fulfilment of values, those are given names such as

love, trust, affection, gratitude, guidance, etc. When relationships are

meaningfully recognised then these values start flowing on their own

from jeevan. For example, when a mother has recognised her child

then motherly care starts surging by itself from her. No five-year plan

is needed for that! We don’t need to find or gather values from

outside. Values are inherent in jeevan, which will get deployed when

relationships are recognised. Recognition of relationships is for their

purpose in family, society, systems, and coexistence. Relationships are

anchored in these four ways.

138 We need to attain mastery with this. The extent to which we attain

mastery, we become capable of evidencing and meaningfulness to the

same extent. Thereby, we start experiencing values. Jeevan evaluates

the values that emanate from itself. Object value is spread

everywhere, while jeevan values, human values, and established values

are inherent to jeevan, and jeevan itself performs their evaluation. It is

such a natural and magnificent activity! No external instrument is

needed for this evaluation. It is about examining the self, by the self,

and for the self. Everyone needs this. We need a way to make this

possibility accessible to all humans. Education-sanskar activities are

carried out on matters of law, regulation, balance, and justice only.

When these activities are duly carried out, jeevan becomes awakened

and capable of recognising relationships. Humans recognise

relationships for their purpose, and as a result, become happy. This is

how we realise the taste activity of jeevan.

Next activity of jeevanis deliberation. The way of deliberation in

animal consciousness is pleasure, health and profit, while the way of

deliberation for humane consciousness is justice, dharmaand truth.

These are the reference points for humane living, which needs to be

grasped and accepted. As we accept these, our efforts become

channelised in this direction. Thus far whatever education, sanskar,

and evaluation that humans did, it was done based on their

sensitivity. This didn’t suffice, therefore humane tradition could not

materialise. Hence, the need is to dissolve the pleasure, health and

profit in justice, dharmaand truth in deliberation. This means

139 pleasure, health and prosperity that is based on the perspective of

justice. With the perspective of justice, prosperity replaces profit. We

achieve prosperity through production with justice, while the way of

accumulation leads to exploitation. By the way of exploitation, we

damage ourselves and we inflict damage to the world as well. This

needs to be clearly understood, accepted and this resolve needs to be

firmly established. Therefore, there is a need for humane education.

Every student will become autonomous by this, and they will have

the following six merits.

​

1.Self-confidence​ ​2.Respect for Excellence

3.Balance in Talent​​4.Balance in personality

5.Social in Behaviour​​6.Self-reliant in Vocation

Such an autonomous person shall evidence resolution and prosperity

in their family, which naturally gives rise to a paradigmfor society

and systems. Family is the fountainhead of society and systems. I have

seen this, it is thoroughly practical. Then comes design of systems.

Understanding gives rise to these systems as a natural consequence.

Each child first receives education from their parents and guardians,

this is followed by formal education at educational institutions, and

finally by the seats of State and Religion which do so in their own

ways. We have not become humane from all this education. Now this

thought, effort, and evidence is only so that we could become

humane, and tradition of humaneness comes about. The benefit this

140 will lead to is - balance in the environment and establishment of

justice in humankind. Living in justice invariably leads to orderliness.

It’s not such a big deal, is it? It is doable, but humans need to feel the

need for it. Whatever humans have accomplished thus far is based on

their sensitivity, but this approach cannot satisfy our true need. On

the contrary, our sensitivity driven actions have ruined Earth, and in

the process, doomed the human race. Therefore, if humans are to

thrive then they will have to recognise humaneness. They will have to

live in humane orderliness, which alone has the possibility of

continuity. The present pressing issue is that crimes against the

environment should stop.

The human systems are in the form of: -

1.participation in education-sanskar ​​

2.participation in justice-security

3.participation in production-work ​​

4.participation in exchange-reserve

5.participation in health-restraint

Participation in all these five systems itself is participation in

orderliness. Such orderliness arises and is evidenced in each human

upon awakening. This completes the summarised view of orderliness,

which every wise person can accept.

Any issue is considered under research or exploration stage until it is

fully understood. We already know how to disseminate the outcome

141 of research or exploration by way of education-sanskar. The first

priority, therefore, is disseminating the fruits of this exploration. The

teachers, who are adept in academic methods, right behaviour, logic

of wisdom and science, will disseminate this understanding. Being

adept means having definitive understanding. After definitive

understanding is attained, one evidences it with one’s own tendency,

effort, and need. The need for evidence is inherent in every human.

How will you remain quiet after you have felt the absolute need for

evidence? You will also become evidence. To begin with, I achieved

this understanding by way of exploration; others will achieve it from

me, academically. After this study, one becomes responsible upon

attaining enlightenment. Evidencing is imminent after

enlightenment. Upon attaining definitive understanding, when we

become ready to evidence it and set forth to communicate it to the

world, we attain realisation in the process. Students will attain

enlightenment only after their teacher’s realisation. In this way, every

person will impart enlightenment to others only after they have

attained realisation. Enlightenment will not happen merely by

speaking. We listen to something, accept it, and then devote ourselves

to exploration. This is the path I took. However, I believe most

people will follow the path of study, realisation, and evidencing.

Question: There are prevalent traditions and there are

common people trapped in them, what is your view about

them?

142 Answer: You have used two words – “tradition” and “common

people”. I understand tradition to be under four heads: 1. Education,

1. Religion, 3. State, 4. Commerce. These four seats are at the helm

of tradition. They’re like the boats that each human sails on, at some

point or the other. In my eyes, these traditions have become

completely rotten and useless, with nothing to offer to those

onboard. They keep bragging still that all their efforts are for our

emancipation, even when we don’t find a single person becoming

emancipated. Instead, the saviours themselves look drowned. On this

basis, I have said that all traditions have become rotten and useless.

The only source of meaningfulness is humans. I have studied that

more than 51% in every human is meaningful. Humans can be

reformed. Tradition, on the other hand, is beyond reform and a new

tradition will have to be established. The prevalent tradition does not

have the substance for reform.

The traditions of education and the State will remain whether they

are meaningful or meaningless. The State at present is essentially a

rule, the basis of which is a constitution, which is fundamentally

power centric rule. The meaning of which is stopping one mistake by

making another, stopping one crime by committing another, and

stopping one war by waging another. What is there for humans in

this? Will anything change by stopping? The more we tried to stop

crimes and wars, the more they increased. It is for everyone to see.

Business cannot let go of its addiction to exploitation. Religion is

addicted to giving assurances and getting respect. Their assurances

143 are - we will emancipate the sinners, convert the selfish into

benevolent, convert the ignorant into learned. There is no evidence

of these assurances having been fulfilled. Humans have kept thinking

- I am wrong, traditions are right. From now on, I want to awaken

humans, not traditions. I don’t deal with traditions. I am a human

and I relate to humans.

Question: On one hand you say that traditions are rotten, then

humans who are products of the same traditions should also be

rotten. Still you say that humans are more than 51% right.

What do you mean by that?

Answer: - The people at the helm of the four traditions that we

spoke about, don’t have inquisitiveness for reform. Those in the seats

of power and the tenets of these seats don’t have the basis of

inquisitiveness. On this basis I say that these have become rotten.

While every human has the spark of inquisitiveness in some corner.

On this basis I say that humans are more than 51% right.

Question: You have talked about “development”. So far

development has meant construction of a road, getting

electricity to a village or an increase in household income.

What is “development” according to you?

Answer: - Development in humans fundamentally means the

development of consciousness. However, we have been calling the

construction of roads and buildings development. Moreover, the

construction of a jail in every district is also called development! A

144 bright new house is called development. I do not oppose this material

development because these are part of humans' common and special

aspirations. However, using these developments rightly requires

social consciousness. With mechanistic consciousness, we will

inevitably fall into errors and crimes. Humans need social

consciousness, behavioural consciousness, and orderliness

consciousness. The Jeevan Vidya proposal is about understanding

developed consciousness. After this, there is a proposal for the

humanisation of education and a family-based self-governing system.

Considering these three proposals, we can see that the lesser the

damage we inflict on Earth, the longer we will last on it. After all,

where will humans live if we ruin this Earth? Therefore, humans are

“developed” when they live with resolution and prosperity in their

families, identify all humans as one race, have harmony in their

behaviour, and evaluate one another rightly, i.e., when they are social.

Orderliness in humankind means their being able to participate in all

the five aspects. This is what I call human development or

awakening. This is the meaning of being social. We haven’t yet found

happiness in our notions of “development”. Resolution, prosperity,

fearlessness, and coexistence all should be accomplished for

continuous happiness. Happiness will not be found without this.

Question: Darwin also gave a theory of evolution which is still

widely accepted. How is your principle of evolution different

from Darwin’s theory of evolution?

145 Answer: Darwin’s presentation is limited to describing the evolution

of species based on their bodily structure. For example, the body of

an insect, a leech, a horse, a cow, and similarly, the body of a human.

He made the skeletal structure the basis of his study. He tried to

explain evolution in terms of how the bones in organisms have

become longer and stronger, considering the human body as the

most evolved and placing prior species in a chronological sequence.

The Darwinian narrative about the evolution of the body has a few

issues, but his description of humans is completely wrong. According

to Darwin, the gradual transformation of apes resulted in the human

body, and in this process, a number of intermediate body forms came

about, which eventually perished.

However, according to me, humans emerged from the womb of

some animal with an evolved brain, where the objective of

exploration in pran-sutras was to establish a species tradition where

jeevan could evidence its awakening. In contrast, Darwin’s theory

claims that a number of indefinite body forms evolved due to

pressure from the environment and natural surroundings. Darwin

didn’t know about jeevan. He didn’t use jeevan as a reference.

Human is a combined form of jeevan and body. Scientists are still

searching for traces of evolution by studying body and bones, and

they give Nobel prizes, degrees, and jobs for these! They consider the

human body as the reference for evolution. If that were so, humans

should have reached their potential along with the evolution of the

human body. But that didn’t happen. Humans don’t get fully

146 defined within the purview of the body or skeleton. As proof,

Darwin himself has written that “I myself don’t get described within

a framework of bones.” He was incapable of describing humans.

You call betterment in rachna vidhi as development, while it is

‘jeevan’ that is the reference point of development. The body cannot

function at all without jeevan. Jeevan itself keeps the body alive.

Neither just the body nor just jeevan is the basis of humans. Humans

are combined expressions of jeevan and body.

The development in atoms is meant for achieving constitutional

completeness. Every atom is constituted of two or more atomic

particles. Each atomic structure has a nucleus and particles orbiting

around it, which naturally occurs in existence. These atoms contain

at least two or more particles. Among many types of atoms, jeevan is

one type. In a jeevan atom, there is no increase or decrease in the

number of particles, which is why it possesses inexhaustible strength

and power. This is called 'development in an atom’. Thus, we call

jeevan a 'developed' atom. Awakening happens after development.

The evidence of awakening lies in knowing and believing.

Recognising and fulfilling activities occur in atomic particles. One

atomic particle recognises another, maintaining orderliness by staying

at a definite distance from each other. This is known as

physicochemical activity. The most evolved physicochemical form on

this Earth is the human body. The delusion lies in jeevan believing

itself to be the body.

147 Question: You had met the Chief Justice of India, Sri

Venkatachalliah, in Delhi and asked him about universal

justice, to which he had no answer. Justice varies between India

and Pakistan, and even within India, there are separate codes

of justice for Hindus and Muslims. There is a lot of confusion

about what justice actually means. You have stated that justice

is evidenced in the family, while we think justice is delivered in

courts. Please clarify this.

Answer: The essence of justice lies in "Relationships, Values,

Evaluation, and Mutual Satisfaction." It is crucial to have evaluation

and mutual satisfaction in relationships. Humans are inherently

related with both insentient and sentient nature, whether we accept

it or not. For example, our relationship with the air. It is impossible

to envisage a world where humans do not have any relationship with

their natural surroundings and other humans. All these aspects of

justice are inherently present within the family. In contrast, courts

deliver judgments, not justice.

Question: Your entire postulation is based on coexistence.

You’ve said that nature exists within Omnipotence. Therefore,

coexistence is all that exists. You say Omnipotence is present in

places where no units are, as well as in places that are fully

packed with units. Please explain this.

Answer: - The concept of omnipresent reality (Omnipotence) is easy

to understand. We can refer to it as Space, Omnipotence, Paramatma,

148 or God. What is this reality? It is the fundamental reality, it is energy.

This reality is such that all units within it can be inspired by it. How

does nature get inspired by Omnipotence? Does it apply a force?

There is a hypothesis that it all started with a Big Bang, and the

resulting force initiated everything one by one. Omnipotence (Space)

does not possess any attribute to apply force. There are no waves,

motion, or pressure in Space, so the idea of applying force doesn’t

arise. Every entity is energized, active, and inspired within

Omnipotence, and this is evident. It is present everywhere. Every unit

is immersed in and surrounded by Omnipresence. Units are distinct

from one another because Omnipotence exists between them. If

Omnipotence were not present, they wouldn’t be distinct. The

joining of units occurs because Omnipotence exists in between. This

way, there is a basis for the composition and decomposition of

entities in nature. Entities are fully energized and therefore active.

This reality was re-examined in another way. Firstly, there are entities

in the form of units, which have a certain volume. Secondly, there is

Omnipresence. The question was considered whether these have the

same volume or different. Omnipresence is boundless, so there is no

way to measure its volume.

According to materialism, where units exist, there is no space,

meaning units displace space. Therefore, materialism considers units

mightier (heavier) than space. However, in reality, as I observed, all

units exist in a state of zero-attraction. Earth, Sun, solar systems, and

galaxies are all in a state of zero-attraction. Zero-attraction is the

149 absolute state, indicating that there is no weight in the coexistence of

Omnipotence and units. Weight becomes evident only in the

interaction of units. For example, weight is evident in the mutuality

of two atoms due to their tendency to form molecules. Similarly,

weight is evident among molecules due to their tendency to form

definite compositions. This manifestation of weight in the mutuality

of units is commonly called the gravitational force. In reality, it

indicates participation in the development progression or universal

orderliness. For example, a stone dropped from a height within

Earth’s environment falls to Earth due to its inherent tendency

towards development. This inherent tendency is commonly called

gravitational force. We understand from these two evidences that

everything in nature is active. Omnipotence is permeative, its

testimony is that each unit is active, regulated, and full of strength.

Wherever a unit may be situated in existence, its regulation, activity

and strength remain as it is – which is also the testimony of

permeative-ness of Omnipotence.

Question: - You have postulated – “Infinite units are

immersed, surrounded and soaked in Omnipotence, and these

units are also illuminated from infinite angles in mutuality.”

Please explain this.

Answer: - I have written an axiom here - Each unit is illuminated in

infinite angles. Infinite angles extend in all directions as straight lines

from an entity and its image remains to be there on those straight

lines. The angle extends to another entity at some place. So, the image

150 of the unit is there on the entity to which the angle extends. This

way, it is evident that each entity is illumined. The evidence that each

entity is illumined proves that illumination is inherent in all units. In

this way, the infinite angles within every unit are in the sense of

illumination only. As a result of your image on me, I am able to

understand your illumination.

Question: Today, the whole world is running after making a

profit, be it in business, employment, or even education, which

you have termed ‘profit-obsession’. This has led to social,

economic, and environmental crises globally. Where can we

find their solution? What is the alternative if the world wants

to escape this vicious cycle of profit-making?

Answer: - If something fails, we can strive again for success. Humans

are trapped in a state of goal-lessness and direction-lessness. They

have not only lost their sense of purpose and direction, but their

plans and programs also lack certainty. Certainty in any program can

only be achieved when the goal is stable and the direction is clear.

Essentially, what is required is a harmonious alignment of science

with wisdom and wisdom with science, like a symphony in motion.

That is the key. If we search for the goal of the current profit-obsessed

economic system, we find it is only about accumulation, comfort,

consumption, and over-consumption, which can never provide true

satisfaction. There is no point of contentment in accumulation and

comfort. Not a single person among the 7 billion on this Earth has

found or can find true satisfaction in accumulation and comfort.

151 This is evidence of the goal-lessness and direction-lessness prevalent

today.

If the goal and direction are definite, then our program is also

definite. I call the current situation profit-obsession because

satisfaction will never be achieved here, but we will keep running like

mad. This is what obsession means. I have seen this madness. You

must also see it. This craze for profit keeps increasing; it never slows

down. What goal will we achieve by increasing this madness? At what

point will we find satisfaction? Even if we achieve accumulation and

comfort, they can only be used within the realm of consumption,

multi-consumption, and over-consumption. It has no other

endpoint. No one has ever found satisfaction from consumption.

These two observations lead me to conclude that the current

situation is nothing but an obsession. If all 7 billion people on this

planet become obsessed this way, who will rescue them? In an

attempt to find the answer to this question, my research shows that

each human desires universal good, happiness, certainty, and its

continuity. All of this combined is the subject of this exploration (of

Madhyasth Darshan). The economic system is just one part of this

entire picture.

Resources are in the form of body, mind, and wealth. All three must

be considered. Economics cannot exist if any one of these is left out.

The economics we have studied so far focuses on money as the

primary resource. Money is classified into two types: (1) metal, and

(2) paper. Paper money is produced in printing presses, and with the

152 widespread accessibility of printing technology, counterfeit money

has become a problem. Therefore, modern economics, which is

highly praised, is essentially the science of currency notes and coins.

We may possess all the currency notes and coins, but they cannot

quench our thirst or fill our stomachs unless we obtain the desired

goods with them. So, what is money? Money is merely a symbolic

unit for exchange. Having a symbol is not the same as having the real

thing. Believing that money can buy anything is madness. To resolve

this issue, I propose that economic resources should be understood as

body, mind, and wealth. Here, wealth refers to common aspirations

(food, shelter, and clothing) and special aspirations

(telecommunication and transportation). In the proposed system,

the items we need will be used rather than hoarded. For example, we

can store the grain we grow for one year, two years, or even four years,

but if we keep it for longer, it will rot. Similarly, a machine or

instrument will rust and become unusable if not used. Therefore,

everything we produce is meant for use, not hoarding. Even if we

were to hoard, it can only be done to a certain extent. The more we

hoard, the more problematic it becomes. Therefore, using resources

becomes inevitable. All produce beyond what is needed for use can

be employed for right-use and purposeful-use.

I have observed something wonderful - the mind is necessary for

producing anything. Along with the mind, the body is necessary for

production. It is only with the union of the mind and the body that

all production happens. In this way, we can clearly accept the concept

153 that produced objects are wealth, which means objects of common

and special aspirations. What will be the benefit of this decision? It

will turn humankind’s mind towards production. We are

discouraging and destroying the production tendency in humankind

by propagating modern economics in education with fanfare. After

this, they talk of specialisation, which destroys production tendencies

even further. The specialist, whose production tendencies have been

destroyed, is believed to be superior. These so-called superior people

demand everything while not doing any production themselves. In

fact, they have the maximum demands. In this way, the

anti-production tendency and lust for consumption together lead to

revolt, rebellion and exploitation with the world. This is the way

humans are trapped. They want to become free from this. I have

attained this freedom. I have no need to exploit anyone, nor do I have

any need to do any revolt or rebellion. I produce in excess of my needs

with my labour. So can you. Needs are ascertained only at the level of

the family, and not individually or at any other level. We experience

prosperity upon producing more than the family’s requirements.

Hence, the need to contemplate Cyclical Economics was felt. It has

been articulated in Hindi and offered to the world. If it is understood

by people, it will lead to the good of all. It will not cause any harm to

any person or any family anywhere. If anything, it will only result in

good. Everyone needs to be free from the way of exploitation.

Everyone needs to be free from the way of revolt and rebellion. The

strategies adopted by politics will never result in fearlessness and

154 peace anywhere. Peaceful living requires a cyclical economic system.

For example, we deploy our resources in the form of body, mind, and

wealth on natural abundance for production, and the produced

goods become the basis of nourishment and protection of our body

and social participation. We again become capable of producing on

the basis of this social participation, nourishment, and protection. In

this way, it is cyclical. Goods are produced when humans deploy their

labour on natural abundance through body and mind. We become

free from whining when we realise that we can always produce more

than our requirements.

We have always desired satisfaction; we have always wanted to be

happy. Therefore, we keep searching for ways to achieve satisfaction,

and when we find a way, we adopt it. It is not about giving up

anything. It is about converting wrong into right, crime into justice,

war into peaceful coexistence, revolt into cooperation, and rebellion

into friendship. We naturally accept these changes. Ask any of the 7

billion people in the world if they want revolt, rebellion, exploitation,

and war. All of them will say no. In my view, no one wants to keep

whining all the time. The cyclical economic system can liberate

humankind from whining, revolt, rebellion, exploitation, and war.

Just as a sick person desires to be healthy, humans inherently desire a

cyclical economic system even while living in a profit-obsessed

economic system. It is about awakening that inherent desire within

us. A cyclical economic system is an inseparable aspect of human

awakening. Its basic principle is “production by deployment of

155 labour and exchange based on labour.” We should produce goods for

our common and special aspirations based on this principle. The

cyclical economic system is sustainable, natural, aligned with destiny,

and co-existentially harmonious. Therefore, we should study it

thoroughly, actualise it in our lives, and, after becoming satisfied,

become a source of satisfaction for others.

Question: Upon seeing the inequality and misery among

humans, Karl Marx gave the concept of “Dialectical

Materialism” which was propagated as communism. It

envisioned a utopian world, in which a political system would

emerge from this communist ideology that will overcome

economic disparity among humans. In the last 70 years,

two-thirds of the world adopted communism, and some

profound experiments were carried out based on it. Due to

this, millions of people suffered enormous hardships, being

hypnotised with the hope of bringing that utopia to reality.

We can now say that communism, at least in its experimental

form, failed miserably. We, the people of the world, have

demonstrated that conflict cannot be the foundation for

happiness in human life. We have heard you say that

“Behaviour Centred Public Discourse” can take humans to

resolution by dispelling problems and discords amongst them.

You have tried to say this again and again. Can you please

elaborate on its true form?

156 Answer: - The hypothesis of dialectical materialism is that everything

functions through conflict. Practically, this can be seen as: you exert

force on me, and I exert force on you, and thus both of our actions

continue. This has been the thought process: both progress together

or one perishes while the other progresses. According to this belief,

only the strong are fit to exist, while the weak are not.

I have seen that there is no conflict in existence. Each unit has

inherent strength. Even a subatomic particle has inherent strength, as

do atoms, molecules, and bodies composed of molecules—all possess

inherent strength. They are capable of achieving complementarity

through mutual offering and acceptance, leading to progress. If they

had understood existence, they couldn’t have written

dialectical materialism. Misuse of intellect leads to the belief

that we alone will remain, rule the Earth, and all others will

perish, that our religion will remain while all other religions

will perish. We hear such boastful slogans daily. These slogans

haven’t provided us with any definite direction or goal, nor will they

ever.

A definite program can only arise when our direction and goal are

clear. I have studied this and impart accurate understanding to those

who wish to study. This is my daily work. It’s not as if I am doing you

a huge favour. Just as air does its work, and water does its work, I do

my work. I am firmly convinced that whatever work I have done, and

for however long, has been for this understanding and objective.

Through this, I find resolutions easily at every turn, in every issue,

157 work, behaviour, production, and exchange. I am happy because of

this, and so is my family. I see that every family wants to be happy.

Every human being wants to be happy and wise; no one wants to be a

fool. Even if you call a fool a ‘fool’, he will curse you and call you a

fool in return. This happens because no one accepts what is
